newsitem.title: USA: Ugly Duckling to buy First Merchants debt.
newsitem.headline: Ugly Duckling to buy First Merchants debt.

text.p: Ugly Duckling Corp said Thursday it has entered into an agreement in principle to purchase the secured debt held by First Merchants Acceptance Corp's bank group.
First Merchant's last week filed for Chapter 11 U.S. Bankruptcy protection in an effort to reorganize.

Ugly Duckling previously said it agreed to provide up to $10 million in debtor in possession financing to Deerfield, Ill-based First Merchants. Both companies finance used auto loans, purchasing them from dealers. Ugly Duckling also operates a chain of used-car dealerships.
The debt totals about $103 million. Under the agreement with the bank group, Ugly Duckling will purchase the debt at a 10 percent discount of the outstanding principal amount.

The bank group will provide six months of financing for the purchase, with interest accruing at LIBOR plus two percent. Ugly Duckling will make an up-front payment equal to 20 percent of the purchase price, the company said.

Ugly Duckling also will issue stock warrants to the bank group to purchase up to 500,000 shares of Ugly Duckling's common stock at an exercise price of $20 per share over a 30-month term and subject to a call feature by the company at $27, the company said.
